_readme: Written by scripts/gen-concept-cars.py; read by the asset gallery.

models.name: concept-buggy
models.note: RC off-road buggy: cab-forward shell, roll cage, open engine and knobby tyres, with the wing and block lamps at both ends.

models.name: concept-rally
models.note: Rally hatch: boxy shell with flared arches, with a roof spoiler, two driving lamps on the bumper, a bonnet scoop and a dark tail bar.

models.name: concept-gt
models.note: Le Mans GT: long low wedge, tinted bubble cockpit over fender humps, with a full-width wing, fender lamps, tail lamps, a grille and a bonnet bulge.

models.name: concept-pip
models.note: Bubble micro car: short rounded shell, glass bubble with a painted cap and chrome bumpers, with frog-eye lamps, a lip spoiler, a grille and tail lamps.

models.name: dash-plus
models.note: Dash with a touch more: square lamps and a grille, a bonnet scoop, a glass rear screen, tail lamps above the bumper.

models.name: bolt-plus
models.note: Bolt with a touch more: nose lamps, a dark airbox mouth, tail lamps on a steel bar.

models.name: carve-plus
models.note: Carve with a touch more: square lamps and a grille, a bonnet bulge, a glass rear screen, tail lamps under the wing.

models.name: rumble-plus
models.note: Rumble with a touch more: square lamps and a grille in the bonnet's face, a ridge down the bonnet, tail lamps.
